    AI Overview
    Yaxel Lendeborg is 23 years old as of April 2026, born on September 30, 2002. The 6-foot-9 Michigan Wolverines forward, who will turn 24 in September 2026, is noted as one of the older players in the 2026 Final Four. He played college basketball at Arizona Western (NJCAA) and UAB before transferring to Michigan in 2025. 
    • Birth Date: September 30, 2002.
    • Age: 23 (as of April 2026).
    • Team: University of Michigan (previously UAB).
    • Hometown: Pennsauken, New Jersey.
    • Background: Born in Puerto Rico, moved to Ohio, then New Jersey. 
    Lendeborg has been recognized for his development in college, having joined at a later stage than some peers, resulting in extended eligibility and a reputation as a highly skilled, mature player.

    AI Overview
    Yaxel Lendeborg is of Dominican descent. Born in Puerto Rico to parents who played for the Dominican Republic national basketball team, he moved to the U.S. at age two and identifies with his Dominican heritage. He is often referred to as the "Dominican LeBron" and has represented the Dominican Republic internationally. 
    • Background: Born in Puerto Rico on September 30, 2002.
    • Parents: Both parents, Yissel Raposo and Okary Lendeborg, are Dominican and were basketball players.
    • Upbringing: Moved to Ohio at age two, then to New Jersey at age eight.
    • Identity:
      Represents the Dominican Republic National Select Team.
